description: Read an actual Orca Whirlpools Position account: current tick range and signed distances, exact principal and latest unclaimed fees when boundary state is available, and bounded mint/vault risks. Supports official mutable and immutable programs and bundled Position accounts. Prices are token B per token A; amounts are gross before Token-2022 transfer fees. NFT mints, bundle roots, lifetime PnL/IL and rewards are not analyzed. Partial coverage is explicit; in range does not establish pool safety. Price: 0.030 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.

position.description: Actual Orca Position account address, not an NFT mint, pool or bundle root
